verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a full REST Marketing API (`GET https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/`) and a Transactional API. Through them you can create contacts, send campaigns, generate account exports and send transactional messages, so core operations can run headlessly from scripts or CI without the web UI. Webhooks add event-driven automation on top. missing for 10: a first-party CLI or CI-specific guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions or pipeline examples), documentation of non-interactive auth/API-key handling, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
